_about: The worked example in SKILL.md: one Format Packs chat insert over frames 612-845 of a video whose narration in that segment is: "Hi Mum, I dropped my phone, this is my new number. Oh no, you OK? Then the new number, and the ask: I need to pay a bill today, send eight hundred pounds." The word start frames are in word_starts. scripts/tests/test_format_packs_skill.py checks it passes the validator.

messages.text: Hi Mum, I dropped my phone, this is my new number
I need to pay a bill today, can you send £800?
